AcceptText: Greetings [PLAYERNAME], It's time for us reclaim the Carved Stone Tomb for ourselves. We need to work our way downwards into the bowels of the tomb and unlock the treasure within, Let's start with the Red and Black Boars that guard the tomb.

CompletedText: That's a great start [PLAYERNAME], Come back later for the next step in our plan.

AcceptText: That was a great job you did with the Boars[PLAYERNAME], We sent some explorer further into the Tomb and they returned with stories of Serpent like creatures and paralysing moths down there, Can you investigate and eliminate the threat for us?
ArchiveText: You helped [STARTNAME] to defeat the Claw Serpents and Wedge Moths found within the Carved Stone Tomb [FINISHNAME]
CompletedText: I can only wish we never see those horrors again [PLAYERNAME], Have a rest and then we will discuss our next step.

AcceptText: We are closing in on the deepest sections of the Carved Stone Tomb [PLAYERNAME], We've come across a grand entrance that we wish to enter. The room however is closely guarded by 2 TuskLords and creatures that continually overwhelm our explorers with their young, I don't like asking over and over but could you deal with it?
ArchiveText: You helped [STARTNAME] to defeat the Tusklords and Wedge Moth Larva protecting the deepest sections of the Carved Stone Tomb [FINISHNAME]
CompletedText: It's done!, we can finally breach the door and seek the treasures within.
ProgressText: [STARTNAME] has asked you to descend into some of the deepest sections of the Carved Stone Tomb in order to slay the TuskLords and WedgeMothLarva found there.

AcceptText: [PLAYERNAME] You must save us!, We didn't mean to unleash the creature within the Kings room. I cannot begin to describe the monstrosity ..... Please save us!

CompletedText: Thank you [PLAYERNAME]!, You have saved the Lost Paradise and given us access to the treasures within the Carved Stone Tomb.
ProgressText: [STARTNAME] has awoken the creature within the Carved Stone Tomb, You have been tasked with defeating the creature known as Razortusk in the deepest section of the Carved Stone Tomb.
